## Review (1)

### gemini-code-assist[bot] · 2026-08-31 · COMMENTED

## Code Review

This pull request removes the `cadence` field from several YAML test configurations and removes the `@requires_cadence` decorators from multiple test cases, updating `tests/testing_utils.py` to allow tests without a declared cadence to always run. The review feedback highlights that removing `cadence` from the YAML configurations will cause Pydantic validation errors because `cadence` is currently a required field in `BaseTestConfig`. Additionally, removing the `@requires_cadence` decorators from several test cases (such as those testing 4B and 8B models) will cause heavy tests to run on every standard PR, potentially slowing down the CI/CD pipeline or causing out-of-memory errors.
